# Open questions for the owner

Facts only the owner knows: devices, films, processes, the station and lab practice (v2.1 plan KD-1, KD-2).
Each question stands once in the repository, next to the blank it leaves (a `TODO(owner)` marker followed by
the question; the debug cases number theirs under "Open questions for the owner"). Until a question is
answered the agent treats the value as unknown: it says so and asks, and never fills it from general
knowledge, the simulator or an example file. To answer one, write the value and its source (a lab file, a
record, a manual page) into the linked file in place of the marker, then run `uv run b1500 dev gen-index`.

22 questions in 15 files.
